answer: What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the forge of the next round.
